home.name: cover star, canvas drawn, flight readout
home.js: (function(){var c=document.querySelector('.px-canvas'); var d=c.getContext('2d').getImageData(0,0,c.width,c.height).data; var n=0; for(var i=3;i<d.length;i+=4*97) if(d[i]>20) n++; var r=document.querySelector('.cs-readout'); return n>40 && c.getAttribute('aria-hidden')==='true' && document.getElementById('home').classList.contains('cs-k-star') && (innerWidth<=1000 || /TRAVELLED/.test(r.textContent)) && document.querySelectorAll('.cs-orrery__planet').length>=7;})()

about.name: home world beside a slate column

experience.name: ringed planet, slates on the far side

projects.name: one planet per project, each keyed by colour
projects.js: (function(){var ps=document.querySelectorAll('#projects .project'); var pl=document.querySelectorAll('#projects .project.cs-planet'); var cols=new Set([].map.call(pl,function(p){return getComputedStyle(p).borderLeftColor;})); return ps.length>0 && pl.length===ps.length && cols.size===Math.min(8,ps.length);})()

skills.name: a constellation through every skill group

education.name: one moon per entry, slates on the far side
education.js: (function(){var it=document.querySelectorAll('#education .edu__item'); return it.length>0 && document.querySelectorAll('#education .edu__item.cs-moon').length===it.length && document.getElementById('education').classList.contains('cs-k-moons') && (innerWidth<=720 || it[0].getBoundingClientRect().left > innerWidth*0.3);})()

contact.name: pulsar signal, links on a slate
